smyx-thermal-fever-screening-analysis v1.0.0

- Initial release of a thermal-imaging based group fever screening skill.
- Supports real-time detection of abnormal relative skin temperatures in multi-person gatherings using thermal cameras.
- Triggers alerts when an individual's temperature exceeds the group average by a preset threshold; suggests thermometer recheck.
- Integrates open-id workflow to manage report history and privacy; only supports infrared/thermal camera videos.
- Suitable for family gatherings, meetings, kindergartens, and nursing homes for early fever screening and health monitoring.
- Provides multi-language support (English/Chinese) and detailed step-by-step operation guidance.
